reviews.text: Thank you Katrina and Sarah for sharing your knowledge and experience. Lyric has getting a great start to her education by coming to your classes. We will continue to come for future training experiences.
Thank you for your review! We appreciate it.

We’ve had such a great experience bringing our puppy to this amazing place!! Sarah and Katrina are both incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and clearly have extensive experience working with dogs of all breeds, ages, and personalities.

We’ve been bringing our puppy Blue here since he was 9 weeks old for supervised puppy play and training classes and we’re seeing the benefits after each session in his confidence and skills. I would recommend to anyone who gets a puppy to bring them here for safe and supervised socialization and training within the first 16 weeks!

The location in Kitsilano/Point Grey is also very convenient, there is plenty of parking out front and it’s always kept very clean inside.

We’re so grateful to have found such a welcoming and supportive place for our puppy and would 10/10 recommend Sarah and Katrina to any dog owner!

We’ve been attending puppy play and puppy classes for a few weeks with our new puppy and both humans and dog are feeling a million times more confident because of it. Classes are tailored to client needs when possible, instruction is clear and supportive, and our shy puppy is no longer so shy. Thank you, we will keep coming back!

We are so glad to have joined the Dog School!! We've started taking our puppy Murph to puppy program classes and puppy play, and they have been fantastic. Sarah and Katrina are incredibly knowledgable, super clear with all information/instructions, and obviously passionate about what they do. The facility is spotless, we have absolute confidence that it's a clean and safe environment for our little one. The classes have been great so far - positive, structured, and they stick to small groups which allows for plenty of individual attention and tailored advice. The puppy play sessions are also well tailored to different sizes and energy levels, and calmly and confidently facilitated. Their flexible credit and booking system is also a huge selling point over other schools we looked at. Cannot recommend enough!

100% recommend anyone to come here! Sarah and Katrina are obviously so passionate and experienced with all types of dogs. The programmes offered are a great balance between structure and flexibility to suit your schedule and goals too.

We have an over enthusiastic and hyper puppy and they’re extremely kind and patient, always making sure everyone in the room feels safe and comfortable. They also do a lot to make this more community based so you can reach out to them (or other pet parents) outside of class, which is so lovely, esp if you have extra questions about training etc. The puppy classes are amazing too, super valuable to teach our puppy to interact with other dogs appropriately from a young age.

Not only are Katrina and Sarah highly skilled trainers, they make going to class fun, informative and you leave with real skills to put into practice!

My dog is small and quite anxious, and I was worried about how she would handle a group class environment. The way they set up their facility and classes made it so easy for her to feel safe and confident while learning new things!

The location itself is great, and parking was quite easy. The space is super clean and well set up, and online booking makes things really easy 🙂
Hi Alex! Thank you so much for the great review. We really appreciate it.

We’ve had such a great experience here with our puppy! We especially love the flexibility of being able to book individual classes and drop in when it works for our schedule, rather than having to commit to a set series.

Their Saturday puppy play sessions are also amazing. They’re free with an optional donation and have been such a great way to safely socialize our puppy with other dogs in a supervised environment. We always come away with helpful training tips too!

Such a welcoming, knowledgeable team and a great resource for new puppy owners. Highly recommend!

This place has been an amazing support to us with our new puppy.  We love the free puppy play times and the puppy classes have got us started with training him.  Plus great info to learn, new puppy friends to meet and all questions answered.

Cannot recommend enough! We brought our puppy in for puppy socials and its an incredible experience that's helped so much with his socialization. We are definitely going to do classes in the future. All the trainers are amazing!
The puppy play is awesome, super well run!

We had a really great experience at The Dog School with our puppy. From the first class, it was obvious how knowledgeable, patient, and passionate the trainers are. The environment was very positive and structured, which helped our puppy learn without getting stressed or overwhelmed.

Every session was well organized and supportive, and the trainers were always happy to answer questions and give practical advice we could actually use day to day.

We’d definitely recommend The Dog School to anyone with a new puppy. It’s been a really positive experience for both us and our dog.

Took our new puppy Winnie to their puppy play program. We were so impressed with the staff and how they facilitated everything. They are patient and adaptive to our puppys specific needs while still managing the class as a whole. We've come to every session we can and have signed up for regular lessons as well!

My dog and I love the dog school! Sarah and Katrina and excellent trainers. They are incredibly knowledgeable of training techniques, I am so happy to have found a force free and positive reinforcement training environment. Classes at the dog school are helping me and my dog achieve our goals and strengthen our bond. I could not recommend it more highly!
Thank you so much!

It seems there are so many options for dog trainers these days, but there is no one I trust more than Sarah and Katrina. They are knowledgeable, passionate, helpful and genuine in their desire to help pet parents raise and care for their four-legged family members. I’ve been doing puppy classes with my slightly timid 3 month old rescue and she absolutely loves the safe space. I will continue to take classes to support her growth and development. You must try a class at The Dog School!

Katrina and Sarah are absolutely experts in what they do! We went to a puppy play class where they allowed pups to play and socialize. They matched based on energy level, size , comfort! We will be signing up for their classes!

My husband and I brought our 9-week old puppy, Lu, here for Socialization Saturday's and loved it (and so did she)! We appreciated that Lu not only got to play with other puppies in a safe and controlled environment, but the trainers offered a few tips as they supervised play. We look forward to beginning puppy classes next week.

If you’re looking for an outstanding dog training facility in Vancouver, I can’t recommend The Dog School on West 10th enough!

Katrina and Sarah are absolutely fantastic. Their fear-free, positive reinforcement methods create such a fun, supportive environment for both dogs and handlers. They are incredibly skilled at meeting each dog exactly where they’re at, adjusting challenges as needed so every team can succeed and continue progressing. For example, when they noticed Skye was already confidently following me loose leash walking, they immediately created a more advanced obstacle course to challenge her in new ways. It was such a thoughtful, personalized approach that kept her engaged, built her skills, and showed just how dedicated they are to helping each dog reach their full potential.

Skye and I have learned so much already, and we’re genuinely excited for every class. Her Intro to Scent Work class was such an incredible experience - it was amazing to watch how quickly she learned to identify and follow new scents, and I gained so much insight into how enriching scent work is for building her confidence, focus, and natural problem-solving skills. Seeing her tackle the weekend’s scent challenge course with such enthusiasm and skill was truly impressive - she knew exactly what to do, and I couldn’t have been prouder.
In my experience, it’s rare to find trainers who are this knowledgeable, engaging, and invested in helping both you and your dog succeed.

We’re already looking forward to our next classes, and I’m so grateful to have found a place that keeps both Skye and I challenged, learning, and having so much fun. We can’t wait to continue scent work and try agility and tricks next!

Highly, highly recommend The Dog School!

Wonderful knowledgeable instructors!
There are many classes to choose from, designed to fit your schedule comfortably.
Sarah and Katrina are always there to support you and will find the perfect approach that works well for your dog.
Discord community is warm and welcoming, sharing plenty of helpful tips to help you and your furry friend succeed.

We attended several of Katrina and Sarah’s puppy play classes and had a fantastic experience. Both Katrina and Sarah are incredibly knowledgeable and do an excellent job helping us understand how to recognize healthy puppy play, as well as what to watch out for. They were also great at matching our puppy with suitable playmates and supervising the sessions to ensure everyone had a positive experience. We haven’t yet taken any of their formal training classes, but we definitely plan to in the future - they’re wonderful to work with :)
Would give 100 stars if I could!!! We love bringing our puppy here for puppy play and classes! Katrina and Sarah are so kind and are incredible teachers! Can’t wait for more classes.
Thank you!!

I have dug into a lot of resources over the last few years in regards to positive reinforcement training. My Shepard mix turned out in fact to be a husky mix. And with it I gained all the independence and curiosity a husky brings to the table. So I asked around my community for help and was brought to Sarah and Katrina. I've only had a single private session (I drove out from Abbotsford) but now i have a roadmap to work on, and most importantly support along the way! Very grateful to have found the Dog School. Thank you!
Great place! Sarah and Katrina are so great at what they do. Our dog Ralphie loves coming by!

We’ve been bringing our puppy, Ralphie, here since the beginning, and we couldn’t be happier. We’ve loved all of the modules and the staff. They’re incredible at breaking everything down and tailoring their approach to both the dog’s and the human’s learning styles.

They also provide great at-home training modules, which makes it so much easier to stay consistent. And they are so fun !! This is hands down the best place to bring your new puppy — or to freshen up skills with your dog. Highly recommend! We are so happy with all the new skills and it’s been fun to hang out with our pup and do some training with him! Great bonding ! Don’t sleep on it ! Go here :) 10/10 experience !!

We are so grateful to have met Sarah and Katrina in our training journey with our dog. Our dog has many behavioural sensitivities, and we have received so much support through individual training and group classes. In class Sarah and Katrina break down the training goals into manageable steps and provide the context to help you understand how it all fits into the bigger picture of dog brain science. Truly so appreciative for their care, patience, and attention - to the pups and humans alike!

I recently took two badge classes (adventure and clever dog) with Katrina and Sarah. I had so much fun! They are both so kind and knowledgeable. Lessons were easy to follow and they made sure everyone got the help they needed. Katrina kindly let me use her sweet dog Maeve, since I don’t own a dog, but I am wanting to learn positive reinforcement with dogs. I learned how to send dogs through obstacles and how to ask them for wait after a treat has been thrown in a bowl, before sending them to it. I highly recommend taking badge classes!

Sarah & Katrina are fantastic. They are extremely in tune with our dog. Their adjustments during class really drive home the lesson they are teaching. After only a few classes, we understand our puppy so much more and our bond with her will only continue to grow.
Brought our puppy, Thomas, here to help with socialization. We have gone 3 times and the staff are always attentive and helpful. Good combination of teaching and play within the alotted time.

Sarah and Katrina are awesome! Ive been training with them for years and have learned so much from them.

My dog and I’s bond has strengthened through their training and they are always wonderful whenever I have any questions about anything dog training.
I sat in on a class today with my friends dog, it was so fantastic and the trainers are so knowledgeable and kind and caring!

My partner and I just took our puppy, Joey, to puppy playtime and we were absolutely blown away! We were a little unsure of what to expect, but the entire session was incredibly well-run. There were plenty of staff members on hand who were all clearly knowledgeable and professional.

I LOVED that they incorporated a training game in the middle of the session that was accessible, age-appropriate, and easy to follow. This also had an added bonus of giving the puppies a small break from each other.

Both Sarah and Katrina are very positive, encouraging trainers who coach effectively. Very hard to find that combination!

We were impressed by how quickly the team spotted when puppies shifted from "having fun" to feeling overwhelmed. Their ability to read body language and redirect behavior immediately made us feel at ease.

We loved learning more about puppy behavior ourselves while watching our puppy interact. We’ve already booked our next five sessions and couldn’t be more excited for our training journey here. 10/10 experience. So happy we found The Dog School!
Attended our first puppy play time and it was a wonderful experience! We will be back for sure 😊. Really professional staff, bonus teaching time and very positive all around. …

Sarah is clearly passionate about her work and that is reflected in how she communicates and interacts with her clients. Not only does she care about the growth of the dogs she teaches, she is great at it too!

Sarah has been a teacher and mentor through my own dog training journey. She is highly skilled and experienced. Not only she makes sure the training plan she’s giving her clients is science based, she makes sure it’s tailored to each individual’s needs and goals. Whether you are looking for foundation training or behavioral modification, she is the best!

The dog school has been a game changer for my giant breed puppy! Sarah and Katrina run small classes that allows each puppy to get the attention and consideration it needs. They’ve also been so helpful for troubleshooting between classes as we bring the training home. At first I didn’t know if it was worth the commute across town for us, but It’s been incredible to watch the positive change in my puppy over a few short weeks since we’ve been attending. Cannot recommend this space enough!

Hi Daniella,
So glad you took the time to review us. Thank you!
Sarah is an Incredible dog trainer and teacher

Sarah was our trainer from puppyhood, we also took the next level manners class, and a rally class with her. She was super clear, competent, helpful, fun to learn from, and had lot of good guidance for us (especially when we entered the terrible teenage years). I believe our dog is so much more dog social as a result of the puppy drop-in sessions as well. Highly recommend!!!

Jasper and his humans are so grateful!
Katrina is a lovely, patience and empathetic teacher! The website is super easy to navigate and the badge classes are so much fun! would absolutely recommend the dog school to anyone with a dog

We are so fortunate to have found Sarah, she was our trainer in puppy classes for our first dog, Nebula, and later for private classes to deal with problems like scratching on the walls for attention, Nebula being more independent and not needing me to keep her busy 24/7, nail trimming and much more. Sarah was always understanding, patient and kind. We are so lucky to have found her, she has opened up the dog world of positive training to us, through Sarah we found resources for when Nebula was refusing to eat, and also found the awesome dog sport of Scent work, since Sarah suggested it to us and even showed us in the direction of awesome trainers.
Later on, when getting our second dog, there was no doubt we were going to have puppy classes with Sarah again. Today Sarah and Katrina are helping us with harness desensitization, I already see so much improvement!
Sarah has been a cornerstone in our training journey, she is someone I look up to and highly recommend. She will care for you and your puppies. You are in good hands with the Dog School!
Sarah and Katrina are excellent dog trainers - friendly and helpful. I highly recommend the dog school to anyone with a new puppy or a dog they need to train.

I cannot describe how much I've learned from Sarah! I took my dog Gabby to puppy classes with Sarah. Gabby learned so many day to day skills that we still use years later, and she was able to practice friendly interactions with other dogs. Most importantly I learned the skills to teach Gabby independently after we graduated from Puppy School. I still follow Sarah on Instagram, and continue to learn from this exceptionally knowledgeable human.

Vancouver dog owners have hit the jackpot! I had the pleasure of doing private lessons with Sarah back when she was in Toronto. Sarah is a wonderful teacher who is great at explaining things in simple terms to help you understand how your dog thinks, breaking down the steps and making training seem less daunting. My dog, Chip was always very excited to work with Sarah and I also looked forward to our lessons together.

Sarah always encouraged me through difficult times in our training, pointing out the successes I sometimes did not see and helped us stay motivated knowing that although progress isn’t always linear, it will come.

I remember the first session when we were working on eye contact outdoors, and how I had doubts my excited about everything pup would ever be able to focus on me. I now have a dog that gives me so much eye contact outside that he frequently walks into things (Sorry Chip).

Sarah also helped us train many tricks. Her constant encouragement and troubleshooting made the impossible seem possible and we now have our trick dog champion title!

Sarah is an incredible teacher! We took puppy classes with her, and she taught us so much. When we were having trouble with our guy a few years later, we reached out and she was more than happy to meet with us and gave very practical, easy to follow directions. She really listened to us and the issues we were having, zero judgment, and was our biggest cheerleader as we practiced. Could not recommend her and her school more :)

I am glad I found the dog school, after several days of searching, and it has become my favorite place to go every week. Sarah and Katrina are top notch, our puppy loves them and enjoys learning/playing/working with them. They listen to and care about the dog owners and our needs and goals - humans, our furry children, learning styles and paces, living environment are all different. I also like their flexible class schedules. A wonderful dog training program that makes a first-time dog owner’s life easier, esp. when you have a lot on your plate. Highly recommended!

Katrina has been with us since we got our high-energy mini Aussie. I can’t express enough gratitude to Katrina and all the knowledge she has been sharing with us. Not only does she teach us how to train our pup, but she also shares and explains behavioral and psychological traits of dogs, which helps us understand our dog even better.
We also left Nola with Katrina for a week while we were away, and she always shared updates and pictures, and I know that Nola was happy with Katrina and her corgi.
Took our pup here for supervised puppy play time and it was a phenomenal and very professional environment! Trainers clearly know what they are doing and care about the dogs.

I would give 100 stars if I could. If you are looking for ANY kind of dog training or behaviour related services, please look no further! I truly believe Sarah and Katrina are the best dog trainers in town. When I got my puppy, Olive, I was overwhelmed and underprepared. I went through a lot of trainers before I found Sarah - but I am so glad I found her! She changed everything for Olive and I. Olive had a lot of issues, including: separation anxiety, general anxiety, hyperarousal, carsickness, body sensitivity, biting, destructive behaviour around the house, and severely low food drive to the point where it was impossible to train with food.

My first session with Sarah, she went over all the issues I was experiencing and created a plan to tackle Olive's issues in order of priority. She was calm, organized, and I could tell immediately she had tons of experience to draw upon. With her expertise,  Olive improved drastically. But more importantly, Sarah's compassionate and creative approach to training and behaviour helped strengthen the bond between Olive and I, and allowed us to grow as a team.

Like many of the reviews here have already mentioned, Sarah truly has a gift for seeing the NUANCE in dog training and human-dog dynamics. So many trainers on social media talk in absolutes and in black-and-white. It is truly refeshing to find a trainer who not only has a deep and up-to-date understanding of the theory behind dog behaviour and training mechanics, but also understands the subtleties in canine and human behaviour and has such a talent for communicating these nuances to her clients.

Olive is almost 5 now, and throughout her pupyphood, adolescence, and adulthood, we have relied upon Sarah's expertise to tackle the many challenges Olive continues to throw at us. Now, when Olive comes up with a creative new problem for me, I no longer despair - I know that Sarah's expertise is just one call away! Thank you Sarah from the bottom of my heart for everything you've done for us!

We were recommended to check out the Dog School by a neighbor and couldn’t be happier with the amazing find!

We have a new puppy (our first) and were looking for a puppy socialization class in the neighborhood, enter the Dog School!  The space is so clean and open, easy parking options near by, and knowledgeable trainers!

Katrina and Sarah are clearly very skilled and passionate individuals who have given such great tips/education during the classes.  We’ve enjoying them so much that we’re now signed up for the key skills classes to help our girl be the best she can be!

I have and would highly recommend them to anyone with a new puppy and I’m sure even an older dog as they too can learn new tricks!  Check them out!
We took our 3 month old puppy for the free Saturday play session and he had a great time! The trainers are lovely and very knowledgable. Looking forward to attending more play sessions!
Thank you!

As a veterinarian who is acutely aware of the importance of and need for positive, humane, and compassionate (for dog and human!) training practices, all bets were off for me when I got my first puppy. 😂 I was so unbelievably grateful to have found Sarah to support Selkie and I as we’ve grown together.

I had such relief that I could leave my job at work and come to classes as just a human with a puppy, anxious that I’d mess something up! Spoiler: I did and I will, and the beauty of Sarah and Katrina and what they’ve built is that there is *space* for humanity and mistakes and messing up. AND, as with all great relationships, when they’re built on trust and compassion, these are usually manageable too.

Selkie and I have been training with Sarah, and now Katrina, since the very beginning and have explored everything from puppy and foundation skills to tricks, rally obedience, and scent detection. I now have an absolutely lovely nearly three-year old dog, and I’m endlessly proud of the relationship we’ve built together with the invaluable support of the folks at The Dog School. From this guardian to a “difficult breed”, I could not be more grateful for all that TDS offers, and would recommend them to anyone, anytime. Thank you Sarah and Katrina for being a vital resource for dog families in our community…love from Selkie and I!

We are so, so very glad that The Dog School is now up and running! When we were looking for puppy kindergartens, The Dog School hadn't opened yet, and so we were forced to drive our car-sick whippet all the way across town. Our Evie is a lot of dog (and yet also quite timid!) and so puppy kindergarten wasn't enough, we needed more help. We looked again for classes closer to home, and luckily this place was just opening. It's exactly what we needed in Point Grey!

Sarah and Katrina are wonderful, both at understanding what our canine friends are trying to tell us, and at helping the humans in the equation understand what part we need to play. The flexible scheduling is unique and very welcome, they have free Office Hours (such a useful idea!), and there are e-mail handouts, too, to help you remember what you learned in class. While we've enjoyed having the trainers all to ourselves on occasion, we REALLY want this place to stay in business, so please come check them out, and tell them Evie (the whippet) sent you!
Sarah and Katrina are so passionate and their education style is incredibly innovative. Great for all levels of training

We met Sarah at one of her tricks classes, and we learned so much and had so much fun! She takes the time to learn each dog and their handler, and shares feedback according to our training style and goals, and dog’s abilities. I really appreciate how clearly she explains the reasoning behind each exercise - it helps us understand not just what to do, but why we’re doing it and how to further progress outside of the classroom. We’ve been having so much fun building our tricks repertoire and learning new skills and look forward to every class!

Sarah and Katrina both communicate really well, are friendly and approachable. They know what they’re doing and care about helping both dogs and handlers succeed. They set us up for success by breaking down each skill into clear, manageable steps and taking the time to listen to any concerns or challenges we’re having. I really appreciate how they adapt the level of each skill to each dog’s progress, which keeps the learning both fun, engaging and challenging.

We’ve had such a positive experience and would highly recommend The Dog School to anyone looking for professional, effective, and enjoyable training!

Sarah is a phenomenal trainer and helped us with our first dog, a rescue mix named Velo. She was extremely kind and patient with both the human learner and my dog. She provided clear explanations and instructions for us, as first time dog owners, to better support our dog. He struggled with a lot of fear and reactivity, and have given us tools to live harmoniously with him. We learned so much from her and anyone would be lucky to attend The Dog School!

Katrina and Sarah are amazing people and trainers!
They’re both super knowledgeable and bring different strengths to their training, which makes such an incredible experience for both dog and handler. They’re opening one of the best dog training spots in Vancouver, and I couldn’t recommend them more. If you’ve got a dog or puppy, you’ll definitely want to check them out!

If there were more stars, I would give them.  Seriously Sarah is that good!!  I've taken several of Sarah's classes and also done some private lessons with her.  Her years of training, her expertise, her keen eye for slight nuances between dog and human, her knowledge of animal and human behaviour, and her ability to convey all of that to the human is exceptional!!  I highly recommend that every new pup owner and/or those with an older dog needing some guidance with specific issues take a class or sign up for a private session with Sarah.  It will be well worth any money you spend to help you and your pet have many happy years together!   I have only recently met Katrina but have high confidence that Sarah would only partner with another equally qualified individual.  What I saw in Katrina is someone with exceptional skills and knowledge in dealing with animals and an easy manner with which to convey that information.  Thank you to both of you and good luck with your new venture!

Sarah has been our pup's trainer since he was 3 months old. Now a 4 year old, he's grown from learning  foundation skills to him working on his Expert Trick Dog certificate. We wouldn't have been able to work through these in a cooperative manner without Sarah's guidance and expertise. It is comforting to know that we have someone on our side willing to troubleshoot behaviours and tricks with us. Our pup has looked forward to every training session with Sarah and I'm certain he will be as well once The Dog School classes begin.

Having previously gone through puppy training, and additional private training under Sarah’s guidance for a challenging case of dog reactivity I can’t understate how skilled Sarah is.

Her background as a scientist, years of positive reinforcement training, love of animals, and love of the job has led to a level of critical analysis, understanding of animal-animal behavior, animal-human behaviour, and an ability to adapt methods to foster healthy bonds leading to happy dogs and happy dog parents.

While this is called the dog school, I’m certain that the humans will be doing the learning and the dog’s behaviour, skills, and tricks are simply a result of the collective expertise.
